info.title: Neo Backend API
info.description: Public REST API for the Neo backend. Operations document authentication, rate limits, and request validation checks. Localization: authenticated requests use the user's profile language; otherwise optional `X-Language` accepts `en` or `ru` and controls localized validation and error messages.

post.summary: Registers a new user with email and password credentials.
post.description:
Request checks
- Rate limit: 15 requests per 15 minutes per client IP.
- Request body validation:
- `email`: must be a valid email address; required.
- `name`: maximum length 100 characters; required.
- `password`: minimum length 8 characters; password must contain at least one lowercase letter; password must contain at least one number; password must contain at least one special character; password must contain at least one uppercase letter; required.

400.description: Bad Request

429.description: Too many requests. Rate limit policy exceeded.

post.summary: Creates feedback for the site or a site section.
post.description:
Request checks
- Request body validation:
- `context`: feedback context is not allowed for this section; required.
- `context.Analysis`: required.
- `context.Analysis.Reel`: arbitrary reel feedback requires a URL or external ID; required.
- `context.Analysis.Reel.CuratedReelId`: required.
- `context.Analysis.Reel.Kind`: accepted JSON values: `curated`, `arbitrary`.
- `context.Analysis.Reel.Url`: maximum length 2048 characters.
- `message`: maximum length 2000 characters.
- `section`: accepted JSON values: `generic`, `today_reels`, `reel_analysis`.
- `sentiment`: accepted JSON values: `like`, `neutral`, `dislike`.
